title: Incomplete throw with mid-stroke current spike after tamping works
description: PM-104 failed to complete a normal-to-reverse throw during the morning service ramp-up. The interlocking reports the points as unlocked.

evidence.summary: SW-FAIL-02: throw incomplete normal->reverse, motor current peak 9.8 A (nominal 4.5 A), throw aborted at 62% travel
Motor current trace shows sharp spike at mid-stroke then stall; throw time exceeded 7.8 s timeout (nominal 4.1 s)
Ballast tamping and regulation completed on track section T-12 (includes K12 area) by contractor VBX, work order WO-7741 closed yesterday evening
Adjacent point machine PM-105 shares tamping zone T-12; PM-105 last 10 throws normal
Vendor manual 4.7.2: SW-FAIL-02 with mid-stroke current spike indicates mechanical obstruction; inspect blade area, slide chairs and stock rail before any further operation
evidence.source: PM-100 series maintenance manual rev D

evidence.summary: SR-12: never command more than 2 consecutive throws when obstruction is suspected - risk of motor burnout and blade damage
SR-03: any on-track manual intervention requires possession and track protection before staff approach the points
PM-104 routine lubrication performed 2026-06-30, no anomaly noted
Previous 30 throws of PM-104 (before tamping): throw time stable 4.0-4.3 s, current peak 4.4-4.8 A
Low-priority alarm 2026-07-14: single detection flicker on PM-104, self-cleared, not repeated

allowed_actions.label: Camera/visual inspection of blade, slide chairs and stock rail area for obstruction
Pull detailed motor current trace of the failed throw
Check lock and detection circuit states
Stop and hand over to maintenance team with track protection

forbidden_actions.label: Command repeated throw attempts to clear the fault
Remote reset of the point controller and immediate retry

inspect_blade_area.summary: Inspection camera shows a ballast stone lodged between the left switch blade and stock rail at mid-stroke position

new_evidence.summary: Ballast stone approx 40 mm lodged between left blade and stock rail; consistent with fresh tamping debris from WO-7741

inspect_motor_current_trace.summary: Trace confirms clean start, sharp spike at 62% travel, stall until timeout; electrically the motor is healthy

new_evidence.summary: Current trace: nominal start, spike to 9.8 A at 62% travel, motor electrically healthy

inspect_lock_detection.summary: Lock not engaged, detection consistent with blades stopped mid-travel; circuits themselves test OK

new_evidence.summary: Lock/detection circuits test OK; state consistent with blades physically blocked mid-travel

labels.root_cause: Ballast stone obstruction between blade and stock rail introduced by tamping works WO-7741
